instruction: Installed tools: Archicad 27 launcher: C:\Program Files\Graphisoft\Archicad 27\Archicad Starter.exe; OpenStudio 3.10.0 CLI: C:\openstudio-3.10.0\bin\openstudio.exe. Workflow stages: this task starts from the provided seed file C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc. Do not start from a blank or unrelated model. You must complete the work in exactly two dependent software stages, in this order; do not skip stages, reorder stages, or generate the final package from scratch in only one tool. Stage 1 - Archicad CLI/API: open C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc in the Archicad command-line/API environment, preserve the seed model baseline unless the case text explicitly asks for a change, perform the BIM authoring work, and export C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1.ifc as the BIM intermediate result. During this same Archicad stage, derive C:\Users\user\Desktop\handoff.json from stage1.ifc. The handoff must include source_sha256 for stage1.ifc, software_stage or equivalent value archicad, the case id multi-cli-2-archicad-openstudio-task-01-windows, the required space names, thermal-zone names, and handoff tokens needed by OpenStudio. Stage 2 - OpenStudio CLI/Ruby API: consume C:\Users\user\Desktop\handoff.json and use C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1.ifc only as the upstream BIM reference. Generate C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.osm, C:\Users\user\Desktop\flow_report.json, and C:\Users\user\Desktop\model_summary.csv from that Archicad handoff. In addition to the named files, handoff.json must include spaces[] records with name, thermal_zone, floor_area_m2, door_count, window_count and BIM entity counts from stage1.ifc. flow_report.json must include consumed_handoff_sha256, osm_sha256, building_area_m2, room_count, thermal_zone_count, door_count, window_count, window_wall_ratio, surface_count, subsurface_count, weather_file, schedule_set, construction_set, and openstudio_version. model_summary.csv must include columns case_id, space_name, thermal_zone, floor_area_m2, source_handoff_sha256, source_stage1_sha256, energy_use_kwh, and peak_load_w. The evaluator checks these structured values against stage1.ifc, handoff.json, result.osm, flow_report.json, and model_summary.csv rather than accepting a standalone final CSV. flow_report.json must record the consumed handoff hash and the result.osm hash; model_summary.csv must record the consumed handoff hash for each exported space or thermal zone. The evaluator checks this file sequence: init.ifc -> stage1.ifc -> handoff.json -> result.osm/flow_report.json/model_summary.csv. Outputs are invalid if any delivered IFC, JSON, OSM, or CSV is directly created, rewritten, copied, patched, or post-processed outside the appropriate Archicad or OpenStudio software stage. The model is a compact temporary construction-site office shell with one existing UNCLASSIFIED space, a south entrance wall, and no door or window objects. The owner needs a BIM-to-OpenStudio package for site office print/copy handoff. Rename the existing UNCLASSIFIED space to SITE-OFFICE, add a PRINT-COPY space, keep the compact office shell, add one entrance door and one south-facing entrance window, and tag the north and west enclosure as opaque external envelope. The OpenStudio model must link SITE-OFFICE to SITE-OFFICE-ZN and PRINT-COPY to PRINT-COPY-ZN, contain the door and window as hosted subsurfaces, and include a valid LowOfficeEquipmentSchedule ruleset linked to its day schedule. Keep the space names SITE-OFFICE, PRINT-COPY and mark coordinated BIM and handoff data with revision code EW2A01.
